description: The caligae were heavy-duty military sandals worn by Roman legionaries and auxiliaries, especially from the late Republic through the early Empire. Made from thick leather and constructed with openwork uppers for ventilation, they had multiple-layered soles reinforced with iron hobnails that improved durability and traction during long marches. Caligae were designed for hard service on roads, rough terrain, and campaign trails, making them an important part of the Roman army’s standardized equipment and a symbol of the mobility and discipline of its soldiers.
requirementsTooltip: Unlocked in Town Phase. Requires “Forging” or “Metallurgy.”
